# docs/templates/public-roadmap-deny-list.txt
#
# Regex patterns the public ROADMAP.md MUST NOT contain.
# One regex per line. Lines starting with `#` are comments.
# Blank lines are ignored. Patterns are matched case-sensitively
# against each line of the public roadmap; the CI roadmap-sync
# job fails the build on any hit.
#
# Coverage notes:
#   - Pricing & unit economics: keep dollar amounts, margin math,
#     and revenue-projection vocabulary in private/PRO_FORMA.md.
#   - Vendor specifics: the public file talks about the SaaS in
#     provider-agnostic terms ("managed Next.js host", etc.) so
#     the architecture is portable and the vendor mix can change
#     without a public-doc churn.
#   - Hardening internals: the public file commits to outcomes
#     (cost ceilings, WAF, security audit) without leaking the
#     specific vendors, kill-switch wiring, or fraud-rule
#     thresholds an attacker could probe.
#   - Internal-doc refs: private/ROADMAP.md, PRO_FORMA.md, and
#     the per-phase planning/QA docs are git-excluded; the
#     public file must not link to or name them.

# Pricing & unit economics
\$[0-9]
PRO_FORMA
unit economics
margin
ARR
MRR
LTV
CAC

# Vendor specifics
Vercel
Railway
Supabase
Stripe
Cloudflare
Anthropic console
OpenAI console
Upstash
Doppler
Sentry
PagerDuty
HaveIBeenPwned

# Hardening internals
pen-test
penetration test
kill-switch
Cloudflare WAF
Stripe Radar
Turnstile
24-hour hold

# Internal-doc refs
private/
PRO_FORMA.md
phase[0-9]{2}-roadmap.md
phase[0-9]{2}-qa-findings.md
